create_HgTokenizer_from_model: create a HgTokenizer instance from a HuggingFaceTokenModel to encode and decode text
encode_text_with_HgTokenizer: encode a string into token indices using the HgTokenizer encode method
decode_tokens_with_HgTokenizer: decode token indices back to text using the HgTokenizer decode method
load_hg_tokenizer_from_path: load a HuggingFace tokenizer from a file path with custom HgTokenizerConfig settings
create_HgTokenizerConfig: create a HgTokenizerConfig dataclass with special tokens like unk, bos, eos, and pad
